title: Very good tool!
body: I like the ToDo and it covers mainly all my needs for the todo app. However, I miss the option to reorder tasks manually in whichever view: in smart lists, in custom views, on all platforms: iOS, web, desktop,...
author: matjasko

title: Was better
body:
- moving the tasks via drag and drop is unreliable, sometimes the task just goes back to the source list without clear reason why
- it’s not clear when the app’s reloadijg the tasks. When I open the app I’d either expect  to see a spinner telling me that there’s new stuff I should await or just block the UI until everything syncs
author: LSU31

title: Suggestions
body:
Dear, app is great, I use it to schedule my private and work tasks.
If you would add an option for hour or start/end of the task and provide a weekly and monthly view this app would have it all!
